svg.title: The salmon data journey: two-day stacked flowchart
svg.desc: An editable SVG showing seven Day 1 chapters in the top row and five Day 2 chapters in the bottom row, joined by a central downward transition. Line icons and cards are pure vector shapes with a white background.

g.text: 12 chapters · from human interpretation to reusable data and shared meaning

g.aria-label: Chapter 1: See the Whole Journey: From NuSEDS to Reusable Data
Chapter 2: Draw the Dataset Before Using Tools
Chapter 3: Write the Dictionary, Decompose Meanings and Review Together
Chapter 4: Build the Package from Your Human Description
Chapter 5: Map Meanings and Compare AI Suggestions
Chapter 6: Explain Code Values and Route Unresolved Meanings
Chapter 7: Validate, Inspect the Test Record, and Explain Publication

g.text: Understand → describe → package → review → validate → prepare publication

g.aria-label: Chapter 8: Choose What to Reuse, Define Locally, or Propose Together
Chapter 9: Build and Steward a Small SKOS Vocabulary
Chapter 10: Turn the Human Graph into a Small OWL Model
Chapter 11: Build and Test Bridges to Shared Salmon Meanings
Chapter 12: Draft a Term Request and Follow Its Stewardship

g.text: Choose → steward terms → model → connect → request community review
